content.summary: The newly supplied source-closure counts reconcile across the summary, manifest and portable bundle, and the principal numerical inequalities trace to explicit finite-family theorem interfaces. Exploratory geometry counts remain outside the accepted proof premises. The counts certify recorded scope, not independent replay.

checks.method: Parsed frozen summary and manifest; counted unique module names and mode partitions, compared the summary module lists, recomputed the manifest digest, and SHA-256 checked every source listed in the portable source manifest.
checks.observation: 161 distinct modules partition into 63 fresh and 98 reused with no intersection; their union equals the manifest. The summary manifest digest matches. All 161 portable source hashes match their files and the corresponding closure-manifest hashes. These are actual byte/count checks; I did not rerun Lean in this phase.

checks.method: Counted distinct names and namespace prefixes in the frozen root audit summary and read the portable README.
checks.observation: The summary lists 66 distinct passing roots, comprising 64 Frontier roots and two inherited roots. The portable README correctly distinguishes the recorded 63/98 closure from its proposed full 161-source rebuild recipe and retains the same-evaluator limitation.

checks.method: Read frozen TwoHighIncidence.lean, ProfileACounts.lean and ProfileAClosed.lean and traced manuscript constants to theorem statements.
checks.observation: The incidence source states 37*H.card <= 126*U.card under four-uniformity, two >=3 trace hypotheses and degree caps 14/9, then specializes |U|=12 to |H|<=40. ProfileACounts derives total61, outsider incidence76, n2=n0+15, degree-sum upper66 and final windows n0 in[9,12], n2 in[24,27]. ProfileAClosed retains I27 as an argument. None of these inspected arguments takes the cap45 diagnostic as a premise.

checks.method: Compared Section6 with the previously read frozen diagnostic records and the accepted portable proof-bundle scope statement.
checks.observation: The 156,960 geometry and20,475 candidate counts are attributed to external exact diagnostics. Both normalized coverage and the universal45 conclusion remain unproved here; the source bundle explicitly excludes exploratory cap45 and failed bitmask/UNKNOWN SAT attempts.
